verdict.rationale: Reflect's own docs describe an in-app AI palette (cmd+j) that runs prompts like 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items' on note text, open-ended and saved custom prompts, and a choice of GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Users can also 'chat' with filtered sets of notes to ask questions and extract information, and semantic search finds content without exact wording. Together these let users draw AI insights from their own data inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted suggestions (all documented AI use is user-initiated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI output quality.
